name: ChatMessage
summary: One message in a conversation with an assistant: a person's message as a bubble at the end of the line, an assistant's reply as full-width rich content, with pictures and files sent with it and its actions. The content is composed by the caller (or mapped from data by a view), so a reply can hold any component. Not for messages between people (a comment thread) or for the whole conversation (ChatLayout places messages).
a11y: An `article` named by a visually hidden "{author} said" heading, so screen-reader users can move message by message with heading or landmark keys. Attachments are a list: a picture keeps its alt text, a file says its name and type. A person's actions show on hover and whenever focus is inside the message, so the keyboard reaches them.

props.name: from
props.description: Who wrote it: the `person` using the app (a bubble at the end of the line) or the `assistant` (full width, no bubble).

props.name: author
props.description: The author's name, said before the message ("You said", "Assistant said") and never shown: the layout says who is who.

props.name: children
props.description: The message itself, in order: Text and Heading for words, List, Code and CodeBlock, Image, Card, Carousel, Chip for a citation. A plain string becomes one paragraph. In a reply, each Heading starts a run: blocks in a run sit an item apart, and runs sit a group apart, like the reply's thinking, files and actions.

props.name: attachments
props.description: Pictures and files sent with it, shown above a person's bubble or under an assistant's words.

props.name: actions
props.description: The message's actions (MessageActions): under the message; on a person's message they show on hover and focus only.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The hidden heading's level in the page's outline: one below the conversation's own heading. Defaults to 3.

props.name: thinking
props.description: An assistant's thinking and tool activity (ChatThinking), shown above the reply.

props.name: streaming
props.description: The reply is still arriving: a soft caret follows the last words and the message is marked busy, so screen readers read it once it's complete.

props.name: name
props.description: The file's name, as the person saved it: "review-notes.pdf".

props.name: alt
props.description: Images: what the picture shows, for people who can't see it. Defaults to the name.

props.name: type
props.description: Files: the type in words, "PDF", "Spreadsheet", shown under the name.
